task.description:
Write test specifications and test code for SPC-01 and SPC-02 (WF-02 Batch B).

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-b-20260815

DESIGN: src/design/spc-01-sub-process-interface-contract.md (PASSED Step 01b gate)

REQUIREMENTS (both SHOULD, Stage 15, VALIDATED):
- SPC-01: Declared input/output contract for SUB_PROCESS nodes
- SPC-02: Contract validated at definition-time

IMPLEMENTATION ALREADY IN PLACE (Steps 02a/02b):
- Backend: src/definition/sub_process_interface.zig (21 unit tests), src/tools/json_schema.zig (validateSchemaShape + 7 tests), src/definition/graph.zig (checkSubProcess SPC-02 hook), src/engine/instance.zig (activation/completion wiring), tests/unit/graph_node_attributes_test.zig (6 tests)
- Frontend: web/src/utils/canvas/interfaceValidation.ts + 31 unit tests, PropertyPanel.tsx interface editor, ProcessCanvas.tsx + DefinitionEditorPage.tsx wiring

TEST SCOPE (write test specs to tests/specs/ and any needed test source):
1. Integration tests covering SPC-01 AC1..AC6 + empty-inputs edge:
   - filtered copy-in of named inputs on activation (only named vars visible to child)
   - missing required input -> parent ERROR (EE-10), no child created
   - input failing json_schema -> parent ERROR, no orphaned child
   - filtered merge-back of named outputs on completion; unlisted child vars discarded
   - missing required output -> parent ERROR
   - no-interface node -> EXT-05 unchanged (full map copy/merge)
2. Definition-time tests for SPC-02 AC1..AC2:
   - malformed json_schema in inputs/outputs -> HTTP 422 identifying schema + node
   - well-formed interface -> validation passes, interface persisted
3. Note: backend unit tests + frontend unit tests already exist; verify they are wired (lint_test_wiring) and add any missing integration-level coverage.

Fixtures must be isolated per tests/integration conventions.
